answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the yarrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
